remarks: In Westport's coveted Long Lots neighborhood, this residence makes a striking first impression, set back in quiet privacy behind mature trees and landscaped grounds. Reimagined and expanded in 2010, the home offers sunlit rooms of impressive scale ideal for both memorable entertaining and everyday luxury, with high-end updates and amenities at every turn. An inviting first-floor lounge with pool table provides room to gather, while the gourmet chef's kitchen showcases premium appliances, an oversized island and countertops of statuary marble, and generous prep and entertaining areas. A private suite above a 3-car garage includes gathering room with fireplace, bedroom and full bath with room for guests and home office. The park-like property unfolds as a resort-style retreat featuring a sparkling pool, patio with pizza oven, expansive sunny lawn, outdoor fireplace and beautifully terraced gardens. A no-maintenance koi pond and a greenhouse add to the rare, estate setting, and a hot tub offers year-round enjoyment. 5 bedrooms include a sumptuous primary suite with fireplace, spa bath with heated floors, steam shower, and luxe statuary marble and nickel vanity, offering a private sanctuary. Enjoy property views from the 2nd floor deck. Walk to the ALL NEW Long Lots Elementary School that's underway and 2 min to middle and high schools. It's privacy, elevated living spaces and curated outdoor living at this exceptional residence 5 minutes to train and Westport's lively downtown
